thag16.4:1.1: Passa cittakataṃ bimbaṃ arukāyaṃ samussitaṃ āturaṃ bahusaṃkappaṃ, yassa n' atthi dhuvaṃ ṭhiti. || ||
thag16.4:2.1: passa cittakataṃ rūpaṃ maṇinā kuṇḍalena ca aṭṭhitacena onaddhaṃ saha vatthehi sobhati. || ||
thag16.4:3.1: alattakakatā pāpā mukhaṃ cuṇṇakamakkhitaṃ, alaṃ bālassa mohāya no ca pāragavesino. || ||
thag16.4:4.1: aṭṭhāpadakatā kesā, nettā añjanamakkhitā, alaṃ bālassa mohāya no ca pāragavesino. || ||
thag16.4:5.1: añjanī 'va navā cittā pūtikāyo alaṃkato alaṃ bālassa mohāya no ca pāragavesino. || ||
thag16.4:6.1: odahi migavo pāsaṃ, nāsādā vākuraṃ migo; bhutvā nivāpaṃ gacchāma kandante migabandhake. || ||
thag16.4:7.1: chinnā pāsā migavassa, nāsādā vākuraṃ migo; bhutvā nivāpaṃ gacchāma socante migaluddake. || ||
thag16.4:8.1: passāmi loke sadhane manusse, laddhāna vittaṃ na dadanti mohā; luddhā dhanaṃ sannicayaṃ karonti bhiyyo ca kāme abhipatthayanti. || ||
thag16.4:9.1: rājā pasayha ppathaviṃ vijetvā sasāgarantaṃ mahim āvasanto oraṃ samuddassa atittarūpo pāraṃ samuddassa pi patthayetha. || ||
thag16.4:10.1: rājā ca aññe ca bahū manussā avītataṇhā maraṇaṃ upenti, ūnā va hutvāna jahanti dehaṃ, kāmehi lokamhi na h' atthi titti. || ||
thag16.4:11.1: kandanti naṃ ñāti pakiriya kese, aho vatā no amarā 'ti cāhu; vatthena naṃ pārutaṃ nīharitvā citaṃ samodhāya tato dahanti. || ||
thag16.4:12.1: so ḍayhati sūlehi tujjamāno ekena vatthena pahāya bhoge; na miyyamānassa bhavanti tāṇā ñātī ca mittā athavā sahāyā. || ||
thag16.4:13.1: dāyādakā tassa dhanaṃ haranti, satto pana gacchati yenakammaṃ; na miyyamānaṃ dhanam anveti kiñci puttā ca dārā ca dhanañ ca raṭṭhaṃ. || ||
thag16.4:14.1: na dīgham āyuṃ labhate dhanena na cāpi vittena jaraṃ vihanti; appañ hi naṃ jīvitam āhu dhīrā asassataṃ vippariṇāmadhammaṃ. || ||
thag16.4:15.1: addhā daliddā ca phusanti phassaṃ, bālo ca dhīro ca tath' eva phuṭṭho: bālo hi bālyā vadhito va seti, dhīro ca na vedhati phassaphuṭṭho. || ||
thag16.4:16.1: tasmā hi paññā 'va dhanena seyyo yāya vosānaṃ idhādhigacchati, abyositatthā hi bhavābhavesu pāpāni kammāni karonti mohā. || ||
thag16.4:17.1: upeti gabbhañ ca parañ ca lokaṃ saṃsāram āpajja paramparāya, tass' appapañño abhisaddahanto upeti gabbhañ ca parañ ca lokaṃ. || ||
thag16.4:18.1: coro yathā sandhimukhe gahīto sakammunā haññati pāpadhammo, evaṃ pajā pecca paramhi loke sakammunā haññati pāpadhammo. || ||
thag16.4:19.1: kāmā hi citrā madhurā manoramā virūparūpena mathenti cittaṃ; ādīnavaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā tasmā ahaṃ pabbajito 'mhi rāja. || ||
thag16.4:20.1: dumapphalānīva patanti māṇavā daharā ca vuḍḍhā ca sarīrabhedā; etam pi disvā pabbajito 'mhi rāja; apaṇṇakaṃ sāmaññam eva seyyo. || ||
thag16.4:21.1: saddhāyāhaṃ pabbajito upeto jinasāsane, avajjā mayhaṃ pabbajjā, anaṇo bhuñjāmi bhojanaṃ. || ||
thag16.4:22.1: kāme ādittato disvā jātarūpāni satthato gabbhe vokkantito dukkhaṃ nirayesu mahabbhayaṃ: || ||
thag16.4:23.1: etam ādīnavaṃ disvā saṃvegaṃ alabhiṃ tadā; so 'haṃ viddho tadā santo sampatto āsavakkhayaṃ. || ||
